newsitem.title: CHINA: HSBC set for strong gains on results.
newsitem.headline: HSBC set for strong gains on results.

text.p: HSBC Holdings Plc's strong interim results should boost the shares on Tuesday, with brokers predicting the stock could test HK$280, after some consolidation around HK$270.
The stock closed at HK$264.00 on Monday and rose to a high of HK$279.00 in London trade before closing at HK$271.75.
Michael Ng, dealing director of Sassoon Securities, said he expected some follow-through overseas buying.
"Some brokers are revising up HSBC's earnings forecast which will also aid buying in the short run," he added.
HSBC Holdings on Tuesday reported a 13 percent rise in pretax profit for the first six months of the year to 2.62 billion sterling.
"The results are at the upper end of the market expectations," said Edwin Cheung, sales manager of Taiwan Securities.
But he said after a strong recent rally, the upside could be limited. "Even though the banking stocks will be the focus, I don't expect too much upside after the recent rally."
